rust_summary: A gated layout hook for the player inventory screen.
doc_summary: Set inventory_screen_layout_listened to receive inventory_screen_layout(layout). The layout has offset in GUI pixels, logical panel width, and show_crafting. It is resolved once per drawn frame and shared by drawing, screen bounds and input. A modified origin is truncated to whole GUI pixels. Width is clamped to 1..=4096; finite offsets are clamped to +/-4096 and non-finite offsets become zero. Custom widths change layout bounds, not the fixed-size vanilla texture; combine with inventory_background_pre for a custom background. Requires native hooks API @API:inventory_screen_layout@.
